notes: Every mapped PNG is byte-identical to its source; animations retain source metadata.
Every Experimental texture has a normalized runtime copy; unused textures do not create missing gameplay items.
The archive preserves all 2,079 original PNGs, including the alternative Classic profile; the profile is not enabled simultaneously.
Crop model texture references translate zero-based modern stages to one-based original stages. Beetroot stages already start at zero. The eighth wheat stage uses the final original wheat frame.
Worn armor and boats use the original atlases on the current 1.21.1 meshes; special legacy geometry has not been reintroduced.
Modern-only buckets, deepslate/raw ores, new plants, rubber-wood building parts, smooth reinforced-stone variants and signs keep native IC2R textures.
Fluids use original per-fluid sprites and animation metadata; tint is white with the original modern alpha preserved.

Three vanilla copper visuals (ingot, ordinary ore, full block) use the original IC2 sprites because IC2R reuses vanilla copper IDs. The change applies to vanilla copper globally; deepslate, raw and shaped/weathered copper remain vanilla.
Vanilla fluid sheet textures remain vanilla; no matching sheet-item textures existed in IC2 1.12.2.
Wooden, iron, bronze and steel storage boxes use the original shared texture and original block/item tint colors; renamed PNG paths are exact copies of that shared original.
